snippet.title: Taverna - Alpha Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Taverna is a first-person social sandbox. Join unique player-made taverns worldwide or craft your own to host friends and fellow adventurers. Taverna aims to redefines multiplayer games, setting a new standard for player and world interactivity.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219160/Taverna

Support the Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1596615319/taverna-online-fantasy-roleplay-game
